literal: Even in seven births, evil things will not touch, if one obtains children possessing good character free from blame.
translation: If one obtains children of virtuous character who are free from blame, no evils will touch them throughout all their seven births.
modern: பழிப்பில்லாத நற்பண்புகளை உடைய பிள்ளைகளைப் பெற்றெடுத்தால், ஒருவரை ஏழு பிறவிகளிலும் துன்பங்கள் வந்து தொடாது.
explanation: This couplet highlights the immense spiritual and worldly benefit of raising virtuous children. The phrase 'seven births' is a classical way of expressing eternity or all future existences. If parents are blessed with children who possess excellent character and are free from blame, the positive influence and merit of such children shield the parents from miseries across all their births. The key lies in the children possessing both good character and a life free from reproach.
